summary.en: The printed shell of the ESP32-S3 macropad that listens: a black tray and deck, a gray switch plate, white and gray keycaps, and a green talk key. Generated in CadQuery, printed on a Bambu Lab A1.
summary.it: Il guscio stampato del macropad ESP32-S3 che ascolta: tray e deck neri, plate grigia, keycap bianche e grigie e un tasto talk verde. Generato in CadQuery, stampato su una Bambu Lab A1.
